title: Gate E Decision Contract — Formalized Evaluation Rules
provenance_statement: Retrospective machine-readable formalization of existing criteria previously committed in docs/MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md (Section 11.1, commit 24ffcc9). Created on 2026-10-21 following completion of E5 evidence collection and analysis. It does not introduce new thresholds and does not constitute prospective evidence.

formalized_decision_rules.PASS_threshold_for_AUROC_description: A signal AUROC must exceed 0.70 above no-skill in ALL evaluated cells (canonical + both repeats) to qualify as a reliably usable score. Falling to or below no-skill AUROC in any cell disqualifies the signal from PASS status.
formalized_decision_rules.stability_definition: Risk direction is considered stable if: (a) the event-level Spearman rho sign is consistent across canonical and BOTH orthogonal repeat cells, AND (b) AUROC exceeds 0.70 in all three cells. Partial replication (order-only) does not satisfy this criterion.
formalized_decision_rules.criterion_3_second_seed_or_order: Criterion 3 requires the risk direction to survive at least one full orthogonal repeat. For this study, TWO orthogonal repeats (order and seed) were executed. The stricter interpretation — that BOTH repeats must preserve direction — is adopted. Sign inversion in either repeat is sufficient for FAIL.
formalized_decision_rules.gate_e_overall_rule: Gate E PASSES only if ALL six criteria independently PASS. A single FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE produces an overall Gate E FAIL. Overall INCONCLUSIVE (all criteria uncertain) routes to Branch C. Overall FAIL routes to Branch C.
formalized_decision_rules.branch_a_condition: Branch A requires Gate E overall PASS AND stable, incremental change-specific signal value demonstrated across all three cells.
formalized_decision_rules.branch_b_condition: Branch B requires: (a) Gate E overall does not support Branch A; AND (b) a specific adaptation/normalization/anchor component shows positive delta vs. source-only across BOTH seeds AND both order cells consistently. BN-no-update near-zero is not a positive improvement.
formalized_decision_rules.branch_c_condition: Branch C is selected when neither Branch A nor Branch B conditions are met by the canonical E2-E5 evidence.
formalized_decision_rules.post_hoc_threshold_invention: FORBIDDEN. Thresholds formalize the plan criteria directly; no rule or threshold was adjusted to alter outcomes.
formalized_decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_label_rule: An INCONCLUSIVE label indicates the evidence is insufficient to support either PASS or FAIL with confidence. It is not relabeled as PASS for any purpose.

six_gate_e_criteria.name: Harm and benefit coexist in relevant conditions
six_gate_e_criteria.source_text: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md Section 11.1: harm and benefit coexist in relevant conditions
six_gate_e_criteria.question: Does TTA produce both harmful and beneficial outcomes across the development events?
six_gate_e_criteria.pass_rule: At least one development event must be classified Harmful and at least one classified Beneficial in the canonical cell.

six_gate_e_criteria.name: A usable score improves on no-skill and reasonable generic evidence
six_gate_e_criteria.source_text: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md Section 11.1: a usable score improves on no-skill and reasonable generic evidence
six_gate_e_criteria.question: Does at least one signal (change-specific or generic) achieve AUROC > 0.70 above no-skill in ALL three cells without sign inversion?
six_gate_e_criteria.pass_rule: At least one signal must have AUROC > 0.70 in canonical, order-repeat, AND seed-repeat cells. Sign inversion in rho across cells disqualifies a signal.

six_gate_e_criteria.name: Risk direction survives at least one second seed/order
six_gate_e_criteria.source_text: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md Section 11.1: direction survives at least a second seed/order
six_gate_e_criteria.question: Do event-level harm classifications and signal directions replicate in both orthogonal repeat cells?
six_gate_e_criteria.pass_rule: Event-level classifications must be consistent in direction across ALL three cells for at least 4 of 6 events. Key predictive signals must not sign-invert.

six_gate_e_criteria.name: Incremental change-specific value remains under comparable calibration
six_gate_e_criteria.source_text: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md Section 11.1: incremental value remains with comparable calibration/acceptance
six_gate_e_criteria.question: Does any change-specific signal (s_null, s_flood_expansion) outperform its best generic comparator in ALL three cells?
six_gate_e_criteria.pass_rule: At least one change-specific signal must achieve AUROC strictly greater than the best generic signal AUROC in all three cells.

six_gate_e_criteria.name: Signal available before declared action
six_gate_e_criteria.source_text: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md Section 11.1: the signal is available before the declared action
six_gate_e_criteria.question: Are all evaluated signals computed from PRE_UPDATE predictions only, before any label or ground-truth access?
six_gate_e_criteria.pass_rule: Collection protocol must use PRE_UPDATE timing. All signals must be derivable before labels arrive.

six_gate_e_criteria.name: Compute overhead and false rejection acceptable
six_gate_e_criteria.source_text: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN_V3.md Section 11.1: overhead and false rejection are acceptable for the proposed claim
six_gate_e_criteria.question: Would applying the best signal as a gate avoid substantial false benefit rejection and harmful false adaptation?
six_gate_e_criteria.pass_rule: At budget=0.20 (20% rejection), the best signal must achieve net realized F1 above source-only in all three cells. Signals that invert direction fail this criterion.

branch_options.A: Change-related evidence has incremental value. Build smallest policy using that evidence with matched generic controls.
branch_options.B: Stable adaptation/normalization/anchor component improves fair controls; change evidence does not. Develop stable-adaptation claim and remove unsupported temporal-risk contribution.
branch_options.C: No method component improves reasonable controls. Complete an empirical study with repeated normalization/seed/event evidence, strong baselines, robustness, and final reserved-event evaluation.

status: ACTIVE — formalized reference contract for Gate E evaluation
